label: estimate, not a certified footprint
scope: Cradle-to-gate material production for materials with a cited factor, plus the transport legs the buyer enters. The UK DESNZ material factors include transport to the point of sale, so entered legs may overlap them; the ICA copper cathode factor ends at the refinery gate. Excludes use, end of life, packaging, warehousing and supplier-specific data.
